interpretation_scope: Human-authored claim-to-proposition mapping. Machine verification binds exact source/declaration/type/dependencies/axioms; it does not independently validate the interpretation, hardware premises or subject continuity.

claims.conclusion: Conservative sensor, drift and effect margins bound the modeled post-effect state; sequential guarded effects preserve that bound.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRPhysicalGuard.post_effect_guard_sound
theorems.statement:
∀ (observed epsilon drift jump threshold actualSample actualAfter : Nat),
  actualSample ≤ observed + epsilon →
    actualAfter ≤ actualSample + drift + jump → observed + epsilon + drift + jump ≤ threshold → actualAfter ≤ threshold

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRPhysicalGuard.sequential_post_effect_safety
theorems.statement: ∀ (threshold before middle after : Nat), middle ≤ threshold → after ≤ threshold → middle ≤ threshold ∧ after ≤ threshold

negative_controls.name: PhysicalBridges.IRPhysicalGuard.omitted_jump_counterexample
negative_controls.statement:
∃ observed drift jump threshold actualSample actualAfter,
  actualSample ≤ observed ∧
    actualAfter ≤ actualSample + drift + jump ∧ observed + drift ≤ threshold ∧ ¬actualAfter ≤ threshold

claims.conclusion: The certified source hold preserves the physical projection under the explicitly supplied pre/post log-to-physical correspondence.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRControllerPhysical.certified_hold_physical_refinement
theorems.statement:
∀ {P : Type} (enrol : Nat → List Nat) (start : UPTController.State) (before during : List UPTController.Op)
  (c : UPTController.Context),
  (UPTController.step enrol (UPTController.run enrol start before) (UPTController.Op.retire c)).snd =
      UPTController.Reply.floor c (c.generation + 1) →
    (∀ (d : UPTController.Context), ¬UPTController.Op.release d ∈ during) →
      ∀ (target : UPTFence.St) (attempts : List UPTFence.Ev),
        (∀ (g : Nat),
            g ∈ target.minted →
              UPTControllerFence.TokenWitness enrol start (before ++ UPTController.Op.retire c :: during) g) →
          (∀ (g : Nat),
              UPTFence.Ev.mint g ∈ attempts →
                UPTControllerFence.TokenWitness enrol start (before ++ UPTController.Op.retire c :: during) g) →
            ∀ (physicalOfLog : List Nat → P) (beforePhysical afterPhysical : P),
              beforePhysical = physicalOfLog target.log →
                afterPhysical =
                    physicalOfLog
                      (UPTFence.run (UPTFence.apply target (UPTFence.Ev.raise (c.generation + 1))) attempts).log →
                  afterPhysical = beforePhysical

negative_controls.name: PhysicalBridges.IRControllerPhysical.unchanged_log_insufficient_without_coverage
negative_controls.statement: ∃ beforeLog afterLog beforePhysical afterPhysical, beforeLog = afterLog ∧ beforePhysical ≠ afterPhysical

claims.conclusion: The finite executable actuator remains coupled to its modeled target and a certified hold blocks modeled effects.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRInstrument.run_coupled
theorems.statement:
∀ (impact : Nat → Nat) (base : Nat) (trace : List UPTFence.Ev) (s : PhysicalBridges.IRInstrument.Instrument),
  PhysicalBridges.IRInstrument.Coupled impact base s →
    PhysicalBridges.IRInstrument.Coupled impact base (PhysicalBridges.IRInstrument.run impact s trace)

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRInstrument.certified_hold_prevents_modeled_effects
theorems.statement:
∀ (impact : Nat → Nat) (base : Nat) (s : PhysicalBridges.IRInstrument.Instrument),
  PhysicalBridges.IRInstrument.Coupled impact base s →
    ∀ (enrol : Nat → List Nat) (start : UPTController.State) (before during : List UPTController.Op)
      (c : UPTController.Context),
      (UPTController.step enrol (UPTController.run enrol start before) (UPTController.Op.retire c)).snd =
          UPTController.Reply.floor c (c.generation + 1) →
        (∀ (d : UPTController.Context), ¬UPTController.Op.release d ∈ during) →
          ∀ (events : List UPTFence.Ev),
            (∀ (g : Nat),
                g ∈ s.target.minted →
                  UPTControllerFence.TokenWitness enrol start (before ++ UPTController.Op.retire c :: during) g) →
              (∀ (g : Nat),
                  UPTFence.Ev.mint g ∈ events →
                    UPTControllerFence.TokenWitness enrol start (before ++ UPTController.Op.retire c :: during) g) →
                (PhysicalBridges.IRInstrument.run impact
                      (PhysicalBridges.IRInstrument.execute impact s (UPTFence.Ev.raise (c.generation + 1)))
                      events).physical =
                  s.physical

negative_controls.name: PhysicalBridges.IRInstrument.bypass_counterexample
negative_controls.statement: ∃ s t, s.target = t.target ∧ s.physical ≠ t.physical

claims.conclusion: The supplied event/history relation preserves the initialized origin; faithful modeled records of different origins cannot merge.

major_hypotheses: closed admission and empty modeled pending queue
claims.conclusion: A closed, drained modeled actuator stays quiescent throughout finite commands and composes with the source hold certificate.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRAtomicQuiescence.quiescent_under_arbitrary_finite_commands
theorems.statement:
∀ (history : List PhysicalBridges.IRAtomicQuiescence.Cmd) (s : PhysicalBridges.IRAtomicQuiescence.Plant),
  PhysicalBridges.IRAtomicQuiescence.Quiescent s →
    PhysicalBridges.IRAtomicQuiescence.Quiescent (PhysicalBridges.IRAtomicQuiescence.run s history) ∧
      (PhysicalBridges.IRAtomicQuiescence.run s history).landed = s.landed

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRAtomicQuiescence.source_certified_log_and_quiescent_actuator
theorems.statement:
∀ (s : PhysicalBridges.IRAtomicQuiescence.Plant) (g : Nat) (journal : List UPTFence.Ev)
  (physicalHistory : List PhysicalBridges.IRAtomicQuiescence.Cmd),
  (∀ (token : Nat), token ∈ s.gate.minted → token ≤ g) →
    (∀ (token : Nat), UPTFence.Ev.mint token ∈ journal → token ≤ g) →
      s.pending = [] →
        (UPTFence.run (PhysicalBridges.IRAtomicQuiescence.close s g).gate journal).log = s.gate.log ∧
          (PhysicalBridges.IRAtomicQuiescence.run (PhysicalBridges.IRAtomicQuiescence.close s g)
                physicalHistory).landed =
            s.landed

claims.conclusion: The closed and fully drained modeled transport/actuator barrier blocks landing under finite interleavings and source finality.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRInFlightQuiescence.barrier_holds_under_any_finite_interleaving
theorems.statement:

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRInFlightQuiescence.source_certified_finality_with_inflight_barrier

negative_controls.name: PhysicalBridges.IRInFlightQuiescence.in_flight_defeats_queue_only_ack
negative_controls.statement:

  (PhysicalBridges.IRInFlightQuiescence.close s 0).closed = true ∧
    (PhysicalBridges.IRInFlightQuiescence.close s 0).pending = [] ∧

        (PhysicalBridges.IRInFlightQuiescence.run (PhysicalBridges.IRInFlightQuiescence.close s 0)
            [PhysicalBridges.IRInFlightQuiescence.Cmd.arrive, PhysicalBridges.IRInFlightQuiescence.Cmd.deliver]).landed

claims.conclusion: The modeled final-application epoch fence rejects old-generation effects, including pre-admitted effects, during the source hold.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.hold_refuses_all_preexisting_effects
theorems.statement:
∀ (s : PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.Machine) (generation n : Nat),
  PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.OldOnly s generation →
    (PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.deliverMany n (PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.hold s generation)).landed =
      s.landed

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.source_hold_and_apply_time_refusal
theorems.statement:
∀ (target : UPTFence.St) (physical : PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.Machine) (generation : Nat)
  (journal : List UPTFence.Ev) (n : Nat),
  (∀ (token : Nat), token ∈ target.minted → token ≤ generation) →
    (∀ (token : Nat), UPTFence.Ev.mint token ∈ journal → token ≤ generation) →
      PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.OldOnly physical generation →
        (UPTFence.run (UPTFence.apply target (UPTFence.Ev.raise (generation + 1))) journal).log = target.log ∧
          (PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.deliverMany n
                (PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.hold physical generation)).landed =
            physical.landed

negative_controls.name: PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.admission_only_counterexample
negative_controls.statement:
∃ s,
  s.floor ≤ 0 ∧
    s.landed < (PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.unsafeDeliver (PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.hold s 0)).landed ∧
      (PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.deliver (PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.hold s 0)).landed = s.landed

major_hypotheses: atomic commit of durable epoch and faithful restart
claims.conclusion: A committed durable epoch floor blocks old effects during modeled finite restart traces under the atomic recovery assumptions.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRDurableEpoch.committed_hold_prevents_old_effects_despite_restarts
theorems.statement:

  PhysicalBridges.IRFinalApplyFence.OldOnly s.live g →
    (PhysicalBridges.IRDurableEpoch.run (PhysicalBridges.IRDurableEpoch.commitHold s g) cmds).live.landed =

major_hypotheses: strict decrease under every non-goal transition
claims.conclusion: An invariant, absorbing service goal and strict non-goal rank descent under every disturbance force service within the stated completed-event count.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRServiceProgress.ranked_trace_reaches_goal
theorems.statement:
∀ {T : Type u} {D : Type v} [Nonempty D] (step : T → D → T) (Inv Goal : T → Prop) (rank : T → Nat),
  (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → Inv (step s d)) →
    (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → Goal s → Goal (step s d)) →
      (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → ¬Goal s → rank (step s d) < rank s) →
        ∀ (trace : List D) (s : T), Inv s → rank s ≤ trace.length → Goal (List.foldl step s trace)

(∀ (trace : List Unit), List.foldl PhysicalBridges.IRServiceProgress.frozenStep () trace = ()) ∧

major_hypotheses: rank decreases on every non-goal physical/observation successor
claims.conclusion: Faithful belief membership, viable control and robust rank descent yield bounded service for the actual modeled state.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.bounded_observed_service_for_actual_physical_state
theorems.statement:
∀ {S : Type u} {A : Type v} {D : Type w} {O : Type z} (next : S → A → D → S) (observe : S → O) (policy : (S → Prop) → A)
  (safe served : S → Prop) (K : (S → Prop) → Prop) (potential : (S → Prop) → Nat) [Nonempty D],
  (∀ (B : S → Prop), K B → ∀ (s : S), B s → safe s) →
    (∀ (B : S → Prop),
        K B →
          ∀ (o : O),
            (∃ t, PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefViability.Post next observe B (policy B) o t) →
              K (PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefViability.Post next observe B (policy B) o)) →
      (∀ (s : S) (a : A) (d : D), served s → served (next s a d)) →
        (∀ (st : PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.Tracked S) (d : D),
            PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.Good K st →
              ¬PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.ServedBelief served st.belief →
                potential (PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.advance next observe policy st d).belief <
                  potential st.belief) →
          ∀ (trace : List D) (st : PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.Tracked S),
            PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.Good K st →
              potential st.belief ≤ trace.length →
                have final := PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.run next observe policy st trace;
                K final.belief ∧ final.belief final.actual ∧ safe final.actual ∧ served final.actual

major_hypotheses: constant sensor and one-step serving action
claims.conclusion: The specified ambiguous-observation finite example starts unserved and achieves its modeled service in one event.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteServiceWitness.nonvacuous_one_step_service
theorems.statement:
PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteServiceWitness.safe
    (PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.run PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteServiceWitness.next
        PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteServiceWitness.observe PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteServiceWitness.policy
        PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteServiceWitness.initial [()]).actual ∧
  PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteServiceWitness.served
    (PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.run PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteServiceWitness.next
        PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteServiceWitness.observe PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteServiceWitness.policy
        PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteServiceWitness.initial [()]).actual

major_hypotheses: finite genuinely completed model event trace
claims.conclusion: A completed event trace and bounded inter-event latency compose with observed service to give the stated event-clock bound.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRClockedService.clocked_observed_service_if_steps_complete
theorems.statement:
∀ {S : Type u} {A : Type v} {D : Type w} {O : Type z} (next : S → A → D → S) (observe : S → O) (policy : (S → Prop) → A)
  (safe served : S → Prop) (K : (S → Prop) → Prop) (potential : (S → Prop) → Nat) [Nonempty D] (time : Nat → Nat)
  (maxDelay : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), time (n + 1) ≤ time n + maxDelay) →
    (∀ (B : S → Prop), K B → ∀ (s : S), B s → safe s) →
      (∀ (B : S → Prop),
          K B →
            ∀ (o : O),
              (∃ t, PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefViability.Post next observe B (policy B) o t) →
                K (PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefViability.Post next observe B (policy B) o)) →
        (∀ (s : S) (a : A) (d : D), served s → served (next s a d)) →
          (∀ (st : PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.Tracked S) (d : D),
              PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.Good K st →
                ¬PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.ServedBelief served st.belief →
                  potential (PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.advance next observe policy st d).belief <
                    potential st.belief) →
            ∀ (trace : List D) (st : PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.Tracked S),
              PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.Good K st →
                trace.length = potential st.belief →
                  have final := PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.run next observe policy st trace;
                  safe final.actual ∧ served final.actual ∧ time trace.length ≤ time 0 + potential st.belief * maxDelay

negative_controls.name: PhysicalBridges.IRClockedService.progress_without_latency_has_no_deadline
negative_controls.statement: ∀ (proposed : Nat), ∃ time, time 1 > time 0 + proposed ∧ ∀ (n : Nat), time n + 1 ≤ time (n + 1)

negative_controls.name: PhysicalBridges.IRClockedService.frozen_clock_is_not_completion_evidence
negative_controls.statement: ∀ (bound n : Nat), (fun x => 0) (n + 1) ≤ (fun x => 0) n + bound

claims.conclusion: An admitted unchanged non-goal state or belief refutes universal strict rank descent even when a different event is beneficial.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRStutterObstruction.stuttering_non_goal_refutes_any_progress_rank
theorems.statement:
∀ {T : Type u} {D : Type v} (step : T → D → T) (Inv Goal : T → Prop) (st : T) (disturbance : D),
  Inv st → ¬Goal st → step st disturbance = st → ¬∃ rank, ∀ (x : T) (d : D), Inv x → ¬Goal x → rank (step x d) < rank x

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRStutterObstruction.unchanged_unserved_belief_blocks_rank
theorems.statement:
∀ {S : Type u} {A : Type v} {E O : Type} (next : S → A → E → S) (observe : S → O) (policy : (S → Prop) → A)
  (served : S → Prop) (K : (S → Prop) → Prop) (st : PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.Tracked S) (d : E),
  PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.Good K st →
    ¬PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.ServedBelief served st.belief →
      (PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.advance next observe policy st d).belief = st.belief →
        ¬∃ potential,
            ∀ (current : PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.Tracked S) (event : E),
              PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.Good K current →
                ¬PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.ServedBelief served current.belief →
                  potential (PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.advance next observe policy current event).belief <
                    potential current.belief

negative_controls.name: PhysicalBridges.IRStutterObstruction.beneficial_option_does_not_force_robust_belief_progress
negative_controls.statement:
PhysicalBridges.IRStutterObstruction.adversarialNext false () true = true ∧
  ¬∃ potential,
      ∀ (current : PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.Tracked Bool) (d : Bool),
        PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.Good PhysicalBridges.IRStutterObstruction.K current →
          ¬PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.ServedBelief PhysicalBridges.IRStutterObstruction.served current.belief →
            potential
                (PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.advance PhysicalBridges.IRStutterObstruction.adversarialNext
                    PhysicalBridges.IRStutterObstruction.observe PhysicalBridges.IRStutterObstruction.policy current
                    d).belief <
              potential current.belief

major_hypotheses: nonproductive steps do not increase rank
completed trace has bounded number of stalls
claims.conclusion: Productive descent, nonincreasing stalls and a finite stall budget on the supplied completed trace force the service goal.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRBoundedStalls.bounded_stall_budget_forces_service
theorems.statement:
∀ {T : Type u} {D : Type v} (step : T → D → T) (Inv Goal : T → Prop) (rank : T → Nat) (productive : D → Bool),
  (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → Inv (step s d)) →
    (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → Goal s → Goal (step s d)) →
      (∀ (s : T), Inv s → rank s = 0 → Goal s) →
        (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → ¬Goal s → productive d = true → rank (step s d) < rank s) →
          (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → ¬Goal s → productive d = false → rank (step s d) ≤ rank s) →
            ∀ (trace : List D) (s : T) (maxStalls : Nat),
              Inv s →
                PhysicalBridges.IRBoundedStalls.stallCount productive trace ≤ maxStalls →
                  rank s + maxStalls ≤ trace.length → Goal (List.foldl step s trace)

negative_controls.name: PhysicalBridges.IRBoundedStalls.stalling_is_counted
negative_controls.statement: ∀ {D : Type v} (p : D → Bool) (d : D), p d = false → PhysicalBridges.IRBoundedStalls.stallCount p [d] = 1

claims.conclusion: The supplied trace is invariant and served within its event-clock bound; the advertised critical deadline uses the exact rank-plus-stalls trace length.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRClockedBoundedStalls.actual_trace_service_and_elapsed_bound
theorems.statement:
∀ {T : Type u} {D : Type v} (step : T → D → T) (Inv Goal : T → Prop) (rank : T → Nat) (productive : D → Bool),
  (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → Inv (step s d)) →
    (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → Goal s → Goal (step s d)) →
      (∀ (s : T), Inv s → rank s = 0 → Goal s) →
        (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → ¬Goal s → productive d = true → rank (step s d) < rank s) →
          (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → ¬Goal s → productive d = false → rank (step s d) ≤ rank s) →
            ∀ (time : Nat → Nat) (maxDelay : Nat),
              (∀ (n : Nat), time (n + 1) ≤ time n + maxDelay) →
                ∀ (trace : List D) (start : T) (maxStalls : Nat),
                  Inv start →
                    PhysicalBridges.IRBoundedStalls.stallCount productive trace ≤ maxStalls →
                      rank start + maxStalls ≤ trace.length →
                        Inv (List.foldl step start trace) ∧
                          Goal (List.foldl step start trace) ∧ time trace.length ≤ time 0 + trace.length * maxDelay

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRClockedBoundedStalls.exact_horizon_clocked_service
theorems.statement:
∀ {T : Type u} {D : Type v} (step : T → D → T) (Inv Goal : T → Prop) (rank : T → Nat) (productive : D → Bool),
  (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → Inv (step s d)) →
    (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → Goal s → Goal (step s d)) →
      (∀ (s : T), Inv s → rank s = 0 → Goal s) →
        (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → ¬Goal s → productive d = true → rank (step s d) < rank s) →
          (∀ (s : T) (d : D), Inv s → ¬Goal s → productive d = false → rank (step s d) ≤ rank s) →
            ∀ (time : Nat → Nat) (maxDelay : Nat),
              (∀ (n : Nat), time (n + 1) ≤ time n + maxDelay) →
                ∀ (trace : List D) (start : T) (maxStalls : Nat),
                  Inv start →
                    PhysicalBridges.IRBoundedStalls.stallCount productive trace ≤ maxStalls →
                      trace.length = rank start + maxStalls →
                        Inv (List.foldl step start trace) ∧
                          Goal (List.foldl step start trace) ∧
                            time trace.length ≤ time 0 + (rank start + maxStalls) * maxDelay

negative_controls.name: PhysicalBridges.IRClockedBoundedStalls.count_budget_alone_does_not_bound_wallclock
negative_controls.statement: ∀ (proposedDeadline : Nat), ∃ time, time 1 > time 0 + proposedDeadline ∧ ∀ (n : Nat), time n + 1 ≤ time (n + 1)

claims.conclusion: The synthetic two-progress/one-stall trace starts unserved and reaches service under its synthetic clock; three stalls do not serve.

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteClockedStalls.clocked_service_witness
theorems.statement:
PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteClockedStalls.Inv
    (List.foldl PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteClockedStalls.step 2 PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteClockedStalls.trace) ∧
  PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteClockedStalls.Goal
      (List.foldl PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteClockedStalls.step 2 PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteClockedStalls.trace) ∧
    PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteClockedStalls.clock PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteClockedStalls.trace.length ≤
      PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteClockedStalls.clock 0 + (PhysicalBridges.IRConcreteClockedStalls.rank 2 + 1) * 4

major_hypotheses: every reachable belief remains in the guarded kernel
rank drops on every productive modeled event
actual completed event clock has valid latency bound

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRObservedClockedStalls.actual_state_safe_and_served_with_bounded_stalls
theorems.statement:
∀ {S : Type u} {A : Type v} {D : Type w} {O : Type z} (next : S → A → D → S) (observe : S → O) (policy : (S → Prop) → A)
  (safe served : S → Prop) (K : (S → Prop) → Prop) (potential : (S → Prop) → Nat) (productive : D → Bool),
  (∀ (B : S → Prop), K B → ∀ (s : S), B s → safe s) →
    (∀ (B : S → Prop),
        K B →
          ∀ (o : O),
            (∃ t, PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefViability.Post next observe B (policy B) o t) →
              K (PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefViability.Post next observe B (policy B) o)) →
      (∀ (s : S) (a : A) (d : D), served s → served (next s a d)) →
        (∀ (st : PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.Tracked S),
            PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.Good K st →
              potential st.belief = 0 → PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.ServedBelief served st.belief) →
          (∀ (st : PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.Tracked S) (d : D),
              PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.Good K st →
                ¬PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.ServedBelief served st.belief →
                  productive d = true →
                    potential (PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.advance next observe policy st d).belief <
                      potential st.belief) →
            (∀ (st : PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.Tracked S) (d : D),
                PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.Good K st →
                  ¬PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.ServedBelief served st.belief →
                    productive d = false →
                      potential (PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.advance next observe policy st d).belief ≤
                        potential st.belief) →
              ∀ (time : Nat → Nat) (maxDelay : Nat),
                (∀ (n : Nat), time (n + 1) ≤ time n + maxDelay) →
                  ∀ (trace : List D) (st : PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.Tracked S) (maxStalls : Nat),
                    PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefService.Good K st →
                      PhysicalBridges.IRBoundedStalls.stallCount productive trace ≤ maxStalls →
                        trace.length = potential st.belief + maxStalls →
                          have final := PhysicalBridges.IRBeliefTrace.run next observe policy st trace;
                          K final.belief ∧
                            final.belief final.actual ∧
                              safe final.actual ∧
                                served final.actual ∧
                                  time trace.length ≤ time 0 + (potential st.belief + maxStalls) * maxDelay

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRMicrostepInvariant.all_recorded_microsteps_safe
theorems.statement:
∀ (drift jump threshold : Nat) (trace : List Nat),
  PhysicalBridges.IRMicrostepInvariant.GuardedMicrotrace drift jump threshold trace →

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRMicrostepInvariant.certified_hold_and_microstep_safety
theorems.statement:
∀ (enrol : Nat → List Nat) (start : UPTController.State) (before during : List UPTController.Op)
  (c : UPTController.Context),
  (UPTController.step enrol (UPTController.run enrol start before) (UPTController.Op.retire c)).snd =
      UPTController.Reply.floor c (c.generation + 1) →
    (∀ (d : UPTController.Context), ¬UPTController.Op.release d ∈ during) →
      ∀ (target : UPTFence.St) (attempts : List UPTFence.Ev),
        (∀ (g : Nat),
            g ∈ target.minted →
              UPTControllerFence.TokenWitness enrol start (before ++ UPTController.Op.retire c :: during) g) →
          (∀ (g : Nat),
              UPTFence.Ev.mint g ∈ attempts →
                UPTControllerFence.TokenWitness enrol start (before ++ UPTController.Op.retire c :: during) g) →
            ∀ (physicalOfLog : List Nat → Nat) (trace : List Nat) (drift jump threshold : Nat),
              PhysicalBridges.IRMicrostepInvariant.GuardedMicrotrace drift jump threshold trace →
                physicalOfLog
                      (UPTFence.run (UPTFence.apply target (UPTFence.Ev.raise (c.generation + 1))) attempts).log =
                    physicalOfLog target.log ∧
                  ∀ (x : Nat), x ∈ trace → x ≤ threshold

negative_controls.name: PhysicalBridges.IRMicrostepInvariant.endpoints_safe_interior_unsafe
negative_controls.statement: ∃ trace, trace.head? = some 0 ∧ trace.reverse.head? = some 0 ∧ ¬∀ (x : Nat), x ∈ trace → x ≤ 1

negative_controls.name: PhysicalBridges.IRMicrostepInvariant.omitted_microstep_counterexample
negative_controls.statement: ∃ observed actual, (∀ (x : Nat), x ∈ observed → x ≤ 1) ∧ ¬∀ (x : Nat), x ∈ actual → x ≤ 1

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRStaleReadingAge.bounded_reading_age_prevents_unsampled_excursion
theorems.statement:
∀ (physical : Nat → Nat) (taken : Nat → Prop) (lastSample : Nat → Nat) (maxAge maxRisePerTick threshold : Nat),
  PhysicalBridges.IRStaleReadingAge.RecentReading taken lastSample maxAge →
    PhysicalBridges.IRStaleReadingAge.SinceLastSampleRise physical lastSample maxRisePerTick →

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRApplyTimeSampleGuard.apply_time_physical_state_bound
theorems.statement:
∀ (physical : Nat → Nat) (taken : Nat → Prop) (lastSample : Nat → Nat) (maxAge maxRisePerTick epsilon : Nat)
  (readout : Nat → Nat),
  PhysicalBridges.IRStaleReadingAge.RecentReading taken lastSample maxAge →
    PhysicalBridges.IRStaleReadingAge.SinceLastSampleRise physical lastSample maxRisePerTick →
      (∀ (s : Nat), taken s → physical s ≤ readout s + epsilon) →
        ∀ (applyTime : Nat), physical applyTime ≤ readout (lastSample applyTime) + epsilon + maxAge * maxRisePerTick

theorems.name: PhysicalBridges.IRApplyTimeSampleGuard.last_moment_guard_includes_sensor_age_and_effect
theorems.statement:
∀ (physical readout : Nat → Nat) (taken : Nat → Prop) (lastSample : Nat → Nat)
  (applyTime postEffect maxAge maxRisePerTick epsilon maxEffect threshold : Nat),
  PhysicalBridges.IRStaleReadingAge.RecentReading taken lastSample maxAge →
    PhysicalBridges.IRStaleReadingAge.SinceLastSampleRise physical lastSample maxRisePerTick →
      (∀ (s : Nat), taken s → physical s ≤ readout s + epsilon) →
        postEffect ≤ physical applyTime + maxEffect →
          readout (lastSample applyTime) + epsilon + maxAge * maxRisePerTick + maxEffect ≤ threshold →
            postEffect ≤ threshold
